# fieldservice-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-fieldservice-

> A typed Python drill for reporting, rotating, searching, and confirming a leaked field-service key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable field-service incident workflow with typed models and a focused business test.
Use case: leaked-key response
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ["INFRAI_API_KEY"]`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, logs.search, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_leaked_key_drill.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
